name: Collective Action and Coordination Failure
definition: Individually rational agent behavior produces a collectively worse outcome and no mechanism reconciles the two.
trigger_conditions: Payoff to defection exceeds payoff to cooperation in a single interaction
Interactions are not expected to repeat, or identity does not persist across them

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: private parties acting on decentralized information without a reconciling mechanism

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F023 Collective Action and Coordination Failure. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F023
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
